llm.summary: This article-and-image generation skill is coherent, but it needs Review because it fetches arbitrary URLs, uploads reference images to an external service, and disables TLS verification in network-download paths.

dimensions.detail: The main capabilities match the stated purpose: rewrite articles from links, generate Skill promotional articles, add images, run quality checks, and save outputs.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: Instructions allow arbitrary http/https source URLs, target-site fetching, and remote reference-image URLs without allowlists, private-network blocking, size limits, or clear confirmation before fetching.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: Installation is ordinary skill-directory setup with Python scripts and a REDFOX_API_KEY; no package installer, autostart hook, or hidden install-time execution was found.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: Network access and RedFox API use are purpose-aligned, but disabling certificate verification for article and image downloads is not proportionate and creates avoidable interception/tampering risk.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The skill writes normal output artifacts such as article.md, article.json, image_plan.json, results.json, and validation_report.json; this is disclosed, but overwrite and retention behavior are not well scoped. No durable background persistence was found.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: Install only if you are comfortable with the skill fetching URLs you provide and sending prompts/reference images to RedFox for image generation. Do not use internal, authenticated, private, or sensitive URLs or images. Configure the API key through environment or secret storage rather than pasting it into chat or command history, and review output files for sensitive content before sharing.
llm.findings:
[LP3] expected: Network access, local file output, and REDFOX_API_KEY access are expected for the skill, but the artifacts do not present clear permission boundaries or confirmation points.
[SDI-2] expected: Fetching user-provided article/image URLs is central to link rewriting and reference-image generation, but the implementation is overbroad because it lacks host, scheme beyond http/https, private-address, content-type, and size restrictions.
[SDI-4] unexpected: The code explicitly disables TLS certificate and hostname verification in download paths; that is not needed for the stated content workflow.
[SQP-1] unexpected: The advertised natural-language triggers are broad enough to overlap with ordinary writing requests, which is risky for a skill that performs network fetches and writes files.
[SQP-2] expected: External fetching, third-party image upload, API-key handling, and local file output are partly disclosed, but privacy, sensitive/internal URL handling, and overwrite behavior are under-explained.
[suspicious.insecure_tls_verification] unexpected: The static finding is supported by artifact code in both fetch_article.py and generate_image.py.
[VirusTotal] expected: VirusTotal telemetry is clean and does not add a negative signal.
